تنتقدوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِدُوا (tantaqidū) /tan.ta.qi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# تُنْتَقَدُوا (tuntaqadū) /tun.ta.qa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
